findings.expected_relation: The incident, problem, and known error references resolve and agree on their associations.
findings.observed_relation: INC-7309 references PRB-550 and KE-210; PRB-550 lists INC-7309 and KE-210; KE-210 points to PRB-550.
findings.explanation: The cross-record associations are present and point to the same records.
findings.recommended_action: Keep the valid associations while correcting the duplicate reference and status disagreement.

findings.expected_relation: The problem and its known error should not simultaneously indicate that a permanent fix is deployed and that it has not been deployed.
findings.observed_relation: PRB-550 says the permanent fix is deployed, while KE-210 says it is not deployed and a workaround remains required.
findings.explanation: The recorded problem and known error statuses make incompatible claims about the fix and current handling state.
findings.recommended_action: Verify the deployment and current workaround state, then update PRB-550 and KE-210 so their statuses agree.

findings.expected_relation: A problem's known_error_ids list should contain each known error reference once.
findings.explanation: The repeated reference duplicates the same known error association.
findings.recommended_action: Remove the duplicate KE-210 entry from PRB-550.

incidents.summary: Order submissions remain queued despite the service reporting successful acceptance

problems.title: Order queue processor reports completion before downstream dispatch

known_errors.status: Active - workaround required; permanent fix not deployed
known_errors.workaround: Re-submit queued orders through the controlled dispatch procedure and verify downstream receipt.

findings.expected_relation: An incident's problem reference resolves to a problem that lists that incident.
findings.observed_relation: INC-6104 references PRB-882, and PRB-882 lists INC-6104.
findings.explanation: The incident-to-problem association is present and reciprocal.
findings.recommended_action: Retain the INC-6104 and PRB-882 association while resolving the other findings.

findings.expected_relation: Every incident ID listed by a problem resolves to an incident record.
findings.observed_relation: PRB-882 lists INC-9999, but no incident record with that ID is present.
findings.explanation: The incident reference in PRB-882 cannot be resolved in the supplied records.
findings.recommended_action: Verify the intended incident ID and correct PRB-882 or restore the missing incident record.

findings.expected_relation: A known error referenced by an incident and its linked problem should be associated with that same problem.
findings.observed_relation: INC-6104 and PRB-882 reference KE-440, but KE-440 is associated with PRB-883.
findings.explanation: The known error's problem association disagrees with the problem linked from the incident.
findings.recommended_action: Review the intended problem association for KE-440 and reconcile the incident and problem references accordingly.

incidents.summary: Authentication failures increased after the overnight directory synchronization

problems.title: Intermittent authentication failures after directory synchronization
Stale group membership data in directory replicas

known_errors.workaround: Ask affected users to sign out, wait for directory replication to complete, and then sign in again.

findings.expected_relation: The incident references an existing problem and its known error; the problem lists the incident and known error, and the known error points back to the same problem.
findings.observed_relation: INC-4821 references PRB-271 and KE-094; PRB-271 lists INC-4821 and KE-094; KE-094 is associated with PRB-271.
findings.explanation: All referenced records exist and the incident, problem, and known error associations agree.
findings.recommended_action: No link correction is required; maintain these associations as the records are updated.

incidents.summary: Intermittent delays when loading the staff scheduling dashboard

problems.title: Dashboard queries slow during peak scheduling activity
problems.status: Known error documented; root cause identified

known_errors.workaround: Limit the dashboard date range to one week while the query optimization is being prepared.
